title: 出口涨超20%：国内传导却弱于台韩，为何国内反应明显更小？
speaker: Joe

segments.en: So you're today when you look at export growth, it's over 20% in China, over 40% in Taiwan, and close to 60% in Korea.
segments.zh: 今天看出口增长，中国超过20%，台湾超过40%，韩国接近60%。

segments.en: But when you look at domestic response, what we found is Taiwan sees the biggest reaction, followed by Korea. The impact in China is way less notable.
segments.zh: 但看国内反应，我们发现台湾反应最大，其次是韩国。中国的影响则明显小得多。

segments.en: Partially because a lot of that gain has been offset by domestic headwinds. Why that matters is because this diverging reaction has really important and different implications for fiscal and monetary policy in each economy.
segments.zh: 部分因为很多收益被国内逆风抵消。这之所以重要，是因为这种分化的反应对各经济体的财政和货币政策有重要且不同的含义。

segments.en: To understand from our economics perspective, you really had to see what is the impact for the actual domestic spillover. When we say domestic spillover, we're really talking about two channels: one is capex, one is consumer spending.
segments.zh: 从经济学角度看，关键要看对国内传导的实际影响。我们说的国内传导，其实有两个渠道：一是资本开支，二是消费支出。

segments.en: Capex tends to be more reactive, for a bigger degree, because profitable companies can easily turn their earnings into capacity to develop new factories and equipment. Why we think Korea and Taiwan stand out is because they have three things working in favor of them.
segments.zh: 资本开支往往反应更大，因为盈利企业容易把利润转化为产能，开发新工厂和设备。我们认为韩国和台湾突出，是因为有三点优势。

segments.en: One is they have a large enough tech sector relative to the overall economy. AI-exposed exports account for nearly 70% of nominal GDP in Taiwan and around 20% in Korea. So when you get that boost, you easily generate a bigger impulse. What's that share for China? It's only 5%.
segments.zh: 一是科技部门相对整体经济足够大。AI相关出口占台湾名义GDP近70%，韩国约20%。所以获得提振时，更容易产生更大推力。中国这一比例呢？只有5%。

segments.en: Besides that, Korea and Taiwan also have tight capacity. When you have additional demand, you can easily get new expansion. Whereas in China, additional demand from external sources is lifting utilization rates from previously falling levels, but it's not yet at the level that you can generate additional expansion.
segments.zh: 此外，韩国和台湾产能偏紧。有额外需求时，容易形成新扩张。而在中国，外部额外需求正把产能利用率从之前下滑的水平拉高，但还没到能产生额外扩张的程度。

segments.en: On top of that, the broader investment impulse in China is also influenced by other factors: weak demand, local government funding pressures, and a property downturn that's still weighing on overall investment.
segments.zh: 此外，中国更广泛的资本开支推力还受其他因素影响：需求偏弱、地方政府资金压力，以及地产调整仍在拖累整体资本开支。
